# Restructuring Global Supply Chains: Navigating Challenges of the COVID-19 Pandemic and Beyond

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Niu, Werle, Cohen, Cui, Deshpande, Ernst, Huchzermeier, Tsay, Wu  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Manufacturing & Service Operations Management  
**DOI:** [10.1287/msom.2024.0879](https://doi.org/10.1287/msom.2024.0879)

**Keywords:** supply chain, COVID-19, resilience, globalization, operations management

## Abstract

Examines how firms restructured global supply chains during and after COVID-19, analyzing resilience strategies, regionalization trends, and the trade-offs between efficiency and robustness.
